items.title: XLM parity and threat model
items.blockedReason: XRC source supports XLM/USD and defaults to a received-rate floor of 3 and freshness up to 120 seconds, but live XLM quote/quorum is unknown. The read-only connector refused the backend for lack of a service-discoverability manifest; the direct XRC sample is a paid update and was not called.
items.nextAction: Verify connected-wallet CreateAccount support and establish an authorized read-only path for the XRC XLM/USD live quote/quorum; assess SDF, Tatum, Blockdaemon, and Ankr research candidates for provider selection and the 2-of-3 result target.

items.title: Stable state and XLM launch guard

items.title: Verified deposits and borrowing
items.blockedReason: No XLM deposit or borrow endpoint/lifecycle exists. The generic routes now fail closed at source level, but Cargo tests/build have not rerun after the latest guard changes.
items.nextAction: After Cargo verifies the source guards, implement and validate the XLM-specific deposit/borrow lifecycle with reserve-aware checked accounting and replay protection.

items.title: Claims, exits, and liquidation handling
items.blockedReason: No supported XLM claim, withdrawal, close, or manual-liquidation payout lifecycle exists. Unsupported XLM routes now fail closed in source, but the latest guards have not been Cargo-tested; Frozen config and generic update denial keep XLM unreachable meanwhile.
items.nextAction: Cargo-verify the new fail-closed route guards, then implement and validate the supported XLM-specific payout/claim lifecycle before clearing WP4.

items.title: User flows, Candid, and monitoring
items.nextAction: Implement supported XLM vault, deposit, withdrawal, and claim flows with explicit pending and unresolved states; keep them unavailable until route and integration safety is resolved.
